title: Azure hub-spoke architecture
summary: A hub holds shared DNS, logging and the optional firewall. The workload spoke takes Internet traffic only through the WAF; the data spoke exposes storage only through a private endpoint. Changes arrive only through the pipeline.

components.name: Log Analytics
components.note: Gateway, WAF and resource diagnostics land in resource-specific tables (AGWAccessLogs, AGWFirewallLogs).

components.name: Azure Firewall
components.note: When enabled, the app subnet's default route points at it, and one application rule allows the storage account's blob FQDN. Its subnets always exist, so toggling it never changes the address plan.

components.name: Private DNS zones
components.note: Hosted once in the hub; each spoke creates its own links, so adding a spoke never edits the hub module. Clients in the spokes resolve the storage FQDN to the private endpoint IP through these zones.

components.name: App Gateway WAF_v2
components.note: Custom rules run before the managed sets: admin paths blocked unless allowlisted, and 100 requests per minute per client IP. Authorization headers and cookies are scrubbed from WAF logs.

components.name: App VM
components.tech: no public IP · no SSH rule
components.note: The WAF backend. Managed with run-command only; default outbound access is disabled on compute subnets.

components.name: Storage account
components.tech: public access off · no shared keys
components.note: Entra ID authorisation by default; managed through ARM only, so Terraform never needs a network path to the blob endpoint.

components.name: GitHub Actions
components.note: Pull requests: fmt, validate, tflint, trivy and a speculative plan with a read-only identity. Main: a fresh plan and fingerprint, then apply only after approval and only if the fingerprint still matches.

components.name: Entra ID
components.note: Two identities: plan (Reader, for pull requests) and apply (Contributor, only inside the production environment). No client secrets exist.

flows.label: short-lived token for plan or approved apply
